WITH editions AS (
    SELECT raceId, date FROM main.races WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND year >= 1990
), best AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS ms, MAX(typeof(l.milliseconds)) AS ms_type
    FROM main.lapTimes AS l JOIN editions AS e ON e.raceId = l.raceId
    GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId
)
SELECT e.date, COUNT(b.ms) AS lap_drivers, MAX(b.ms_type) AS storage,
       COUNT(r.fastestLapTime) AS summaries, MIN(r.fastestLapTime) AS sample,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND b.ms IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS summary_only
FROM editions AS e LEFT JOIN main.results AS r ON r.raceId = e.raceId
LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.raceId = r.raceId AND b.driverId = r.driverId
GROUP BY e.raceId ORDER BY e.date

WITH editions AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM main.races
    WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND year >= 1990
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM main.lapTimes AS l
    JOIN editions AS e ON e.raceId = l.raceId
    GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId
    HAVING MIN(l.milliseconds) > 90000
)
SELECT e.date, d.forename, d.surname,
       CASE WHEN f.fastest_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
           printf('%d:%02d.%03d', f.fastest_ms / 60000,
                  (f.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60, f.fastest_ms % 1000)
       END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM editions AS e
LEFT JOIN fastest_laps AS f ON f.raceId = e.raceId
LEFT JOIN main.drivers AS d ON d.driverId = f.driverId
ORDER BY e.date, d.surname, d.forename
